name: Annabel
source:
The perfect girl that lives in a extravagant castle who is also capable of noticing what troubles the lives of other around her. The closest to a princess you will ever meet, she has a passion for cooking, a task for "servants" that actually entertains her way more than she would like to. Her upbringing gave her an aura of superiority that she doesn't know is openly in display.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/innocenceversus/status/1019660566355435525] Twitter[/url]]
